answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the thread of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
